{{Quote|Now, if you will excuse me, I must join Brother Kranch in inspecting the Rust Gardens.|Brother [[Fivelines]], to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Rust Never Sleeps">{{StoryCite|story=Rust Never Sleeps|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 156}}</ref>}}
The '''Rust Gardens''' were a location on the junkyard [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ronyards/Legends|Ronyards]]. It was most likely another site of god-worshiping [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who praised Ronyards itself, believing that the whole [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was a droid [[God/Legends|god]].
